title: Men’s Long Jump World Rankings, November 2026
desc: The ten highest-ranked men in the World Athletics long jump table on 17 November 2026, ordered by ranking points.

source.name: World Athletics — Men’s Long Jump World Rankings
source.note: On 20 November 2026 (Korea time), the AllRanks assistant (Codex) checked all ten names, federation codes, places and ranking scores against the World Athletics edition dated 17 November. This snapshot covers places 1–10. Mingkun Zhang held tenth with 1,257 points, ahead of Yuhao Shi on 1,255. Scores are expressed in ranking points rather than jump distances.
